prompt: Design a vertical Mid-Autumn Festival greeting poster for teachers, intended for WeChat chat windows and mobile forwarding. It targets respected teachers, designed for short viewing time but requiring full legibility, with information density between text-light and standard. The core visual language is 'Real Objects Crossing Geometric Emotional Windows': featuring a realistic full moon, osmanthus branches, and a few osmanthus flowers as the subject, depicting a single visual event where 'moonlight and blessings pass through the window to reach the teacher.' The scene features a narrow, low-saturation light champagne gold geometric block acting as a visual anchor and spatial container. The block resembles a quiet emotional window illuminated by moonlight, maintaining clear controlled boundaries and slight translucency. The full moon is inside the window, with osmanthus branches naturally emerging from one end, with leaves, flowers, and a small patch of moonlight crossing the boundary and extending into a large area of whitespace, creating a real sense of spatial penetration; the subject must not be completely trapped by the color block nor turn into a decorative icon. The background is a 'Moonlit Classroom Air Field' related to the theme: warm ivory white to very light fog gray whitespace, like air illuminated by moonlight by a classroom window at night. In the distance, only very faint, almost transparent window frame outlines and soothing lunar arcs are kept, allowing the subject to emerge from a quiet distance and preserving a truly clean breathing zone for the text. Add only a few thin-line lunar phases and osmanthus branch shadows related to the Mid-Autumn and teacher-student emotions; the surface should be complete, clean, and matte, with only subtle controlled brightness changes. Avoid irrelevant scenery, crowded decorations, or dramatic dark scenes. The text must accurately present the following Chinese, with no pseudo-text, garbled characters, extra English, or unauthorized content, maintaining natural and clear Simplified Chinese fonts: 1. '中秋安康' (Mid-Autumn Well-being) — Main title, first reading entry, gentle and solemn high-recognition title lock. 2. '致敬爱的老师' (To My Dear Teacher) — Addressee, short kicker, establishing a cordial identity confirmation with the main title. 3. '愿月满人安，桃李芬芳' (May the moon be full and people be safe, may your students flourish) — Festival wish, authored expression, as an emotional promise following the main title. 4. '感谢您的悉心教导' (Thank you for your careful teaching) — Teacher-student emotional explanation, authored expression, appearing as a short sentence or lightweight callout, performing the gratitude function. 5. '一轮明月寄相思，一声祝福表心意' (A bright moon sends yearning, a blessing expresses my heart) — Closing copy, authored expression, as a quiet bottom/edge instruction line, completing the reading loop from festival to teacher's grace. Reading order: Addressee → Main title → Festival wish → Gratitude explanation → Closing copy. Text forms 4 readable blocks: kicker and main title are adjacent but clearly layered; the wish stands independently as a soft short sentence; gratitude and closing copy form a lightweight coda. Most whitespace remains text-free to allow the moonlit window and crossing subject sufficient space. No dates, schools, names, institutions, contact info, locations, or signatures, as these weren't provided and shouldn't be fabricated. The composition uses a complete editorial-style greeting poster layout: the geometric window and realistic moon-osmanthus subject form the sole visual focus, with text naturally organized along the relationship of moonlight spilling from the window, creating a soothing reading path from the top address to the title near the subject and then to the bottom wish coda; text is not floating on irrelevant images but echoes the window edges, moonlight, and whitespace. Preserve Oriental whitespace, modern order, natural vitality, light luxury quality, and restrained editorial temperament, avoiding template-like stacking. The color scheme uses low-saturation warm moonlight: ivory white and very light fog gray for large areas, light champagne gold windows and soft moonlight for festival warmth, the moon surface is natural warm white, osmanthus and branches use realistic but restrained pale gold, olive green, and a small amount of deep gray-brown as visual anchors, and text uses soft deep gray-brown rather than pure black. Maintain high brightness, low to medium-low saturation, and soft contrast, making viewers feel peaceful, cordial, respected, and gently remembered; the subject and whitespace are clearly separated, but the overall effect is not heavy, noisy, or using high-saturation festive red and gold. The typography adopts a modern humanistic editorial temperament suitable for Chinese mobile reading: the main title is a clear, slightly scholarly, steady Chinese display font, strokes have a warm hand-written feel but edges are precise and complete; auxiliary text uses lightweight, regular, and stretched Chinese arrangement to form rhythm, distinguishing address, wish, gratitude, and closure through font weight, density, whitespace, and line length, without stacking all text in the same size centered. Text enters the scene like moonlight, emphasized near the window edges and appropriately retreating in the whitespace; keep Simplified Chinese naturally legible with all characters complete and clear. The subject uses fine realistic photographic texture: the moon surface has restrained real circular shading and soft halo, the slender branches of osmanthus, clusters of small flowers, and leaves have identifiable natural forms and delicate layers; completed with soft diffuse moonlight, clean matte surfaces, precisely controlled edges and natural spatial depth. No heavy shadows, no cartoonization, no 3D icons, no watermarks, no UI elements, no pseudo-text, no causeless symbols, no cheap template feel. THEORY_LOGIC = SET[Whitespace Composition::Visual Metaphor::Editorial Hierarchy] || SYNTHESIS[Using the window as a relational boundary, allowing the moon and osmanthus to cross the boundary into quiet whitespace; using the main title, wishes, gratitude, and closure to form a progressive rhythm from recognition to emotional resonance, keeping the teacher-gratitude theme clear, gentle, and respectful in fast mobile reading] METAPHOR_LOGIC = Moonlight passes through the emotional window, bringing Mid-Autumn reunion and osmanthus fragrance across the boundary to the teacher, with whitespace becoming a quiet space for gratitude to be heard.
